X-Tenant-ID header, falling back to the user's home tenant), the
user's memberships (so the frontend can restore ``currentTenantRole``
on page refresh), ``tenant_required``, and ``capabilities``.

legacy ``{valid, user_id, tenant_id}`` minimal shape is dropped.

Mirrors Go's ``OIDCConfigResponse``: when OIDC is not enabled,
``provider_display_name`` is omitted (Go's ``omitempty`` / Python
serialises ``None`` as ``null`` and we route the value through
``None`` so the JSON shape matches).

Exchange an OIDC authorization code for a session.

The endpoint is unauthenticated by design and therefore gated by
``Settings.auto_setup_enabled``; when disabled it reads as 404 so a
public deployment does not advertise a bootstrap surface.

valid request returns the success envelope without a probe.

supported storage engine; the live connectivity probe is a
deferred seam that lands with the storage-backend transport layer.
A supported provider yields the success envelope with an explicit
``ok=false`` so the UI does not mistake the deferred probe for a
confirmed connection.

new workspace id so the next JWT-mint lands here (mirrors Go's

the auth middleware's fallback fires.

addressable through the per-workspace routes when the key's

Mirrors Go's ``OIDCConfigResponse`` — ``provider_display_name`` is
omitted (omitempty) when the OIDC provider is not configured, so
the field is ``Optional`` here and serialised as ``None`` when the
value is missing.

OllamaModelsEnvelope.title: OllamaModelsEnvelope
OllamaModelsEnvelope.description:
``{"success": true, "data": [...]}`` — flat list of models.

Mirrors ``docs/api/initialization.md`` for ``GET
/initialization/ollama/models``. The flat ``list[OllamaModelInfo]``
payload is the wire shape; the wrapped ``{models: [...]}`` view
was used in an earlier scaffold.

ParserEngineCheckRequest.title: ParserEngineCheckRequest
ParserEngineCheckRequest.description:
Body for ``POST /system/parser-engines/check``.

Mirrors the upstream ``ParserEngineConfig`` shape (the same body
the save endpoint accepts) so the UI can test a candidate
configuration without persisting it.

ParserEngineInfo.title: ParserEngineInfo
ParserEngineInfo.description:
One registered parser engine (``types.ParserEngineInfo``).

The Go struct has no ``json`` tags, so its wire keys are the
PascalCase field names; the aliases reproduce that exactly.

ParserEnginesResponse.title: ParserEnginesResponse
ParserEnginesResponse.description:
``{"success": true, "data": [...], "docreader_addr": ..., ...}``.

The parser-engine list response carries the docreader connection
metadata as envelope siblings, mirroring the upstream handler's
flat JSON object. Engine entries use the wire shape from
:class:`ParserEngineInfo` (PascalCase keys).

PendingInvitationsCountData.title: PendingInvitationsCountData
PendingInvitationsCountData.description: Inner ``data`` payload of the pending-count envelope.

PlatformAPIKeyResponse.title: PlatformAPIKeyResponse
PlatformAPIKeyResponse.description: Wire shape for one platform API key (token always masked).

PreviewChunkResult.title: PreviewChunkResult
PreviewChunkResult.description: One chunk emitted during a preview.

PreviewChunkingData.title: PreviewChunkingData
PreviewChunkingData.description: The full preview payload: chunks plus tier diagnostics.

PreviewChunkingPayload.title: PreviewChunkingPayload
PreviewChunkingPayload.description:
Chunking knobs the preview honours; mirrors the snake_case config.

Only the splitter-relevant fields are exposed - the full chunking
config carries parser-engine rules and parent-child sizes the preview
path does not need.

PreviewChunkingProfile.title: PreviewChunkingProfile
PreviewChunkingProfile.description: Document profile that drove tier selection.

PreviewChunkingStats.title: PreviewChunkingStats
PreviewChunkingStats.description:
Chunk-size distribution over the full (pre-truncation) chunk set.

The summary fields default to 0 so an empty chunk set still serializes
a well-formed distribution (mirrors the upstream zero-value stats).

PreviewTierRejection.title: PreviewTierRejection
PreviewTierRejection.description: Why one chunking tier was rejected and the chain advanced.

PromoteUserRequest.title: PromoteUserRequest
PromoteUserRequest.description:
Body for ``POST /system/admin/promote``.

``user_id`` takes priority when both identifiers are supplied.

ProviderTypeMeta.title: ProviderTypeMeta
ProviderTypeMeta.description:
Catalog metadata for one model provider.

The wire JSON keeps camelCase (``defaultUrls``, ``modelTypes``,
``requiresAuth``, ``extraFields``) so a UI consumer can drop in
unchanged.

QuestionGenerationBody.title: QuestionGenerationBody
QuestionGenerationBody.description: Question-generation fields the editor sends as ``questionGeneration``.

ReconnectDocReaderRequest.title: ReconnectDocReaderRequest
ReconnectDocReaderRequest.description:
Body for ``POST /system/docreader/reconnect``.

``addr`` is the docreader connection address; the upstream handler
rejects blank or SSRF-unsafe values with ``400``.

RefreshTokenRequest.title: RefreshTokenRequest
RefreshTokenRequest.description:
Body for ``POST /auth/refresh``.

Strict camelCase to match Go's
``{RefreshToken string json:"refreshToken" binding:"required"}``.
The ``refresh_token`` snake_case form is rejected to keep the wire
contract identical on both sides.

RegisterResponse.title: RegisterResponse
RegisterResponse.description: Registration response. Field names mirror Go's contract.

ResetPasswordResponse.title: ResetPasswordResponse
ResetPasswordResponse.description: Wire shape for the successful password-reset response.

ResourceResponse.title: ResourceResponse
ResourceResponse.description:
Wire shape for one listed external resource — ``types.Resource``.

Not in the frozen contracts: it is connector-protocol output rather
than a persisted entity, so it is shaped here alongside its endpoint.

RuntimeQueueStat.title: RuntimeQueueStat
RuntimeQueueStat.description: Read-only depth snapshot of one queue (asynq QueueInfo semantics).

RuntimeWorkerPool.title: RuntimeWorkerPool
RuntimeWorkerPool.description: One worker pool's configured concurrency + live aggregate state.

SearchKnowledgeRequest.title: SearchKnowledgeRequest
SearchKnowledgeRequest.description: Body of the retrieval-only knowledge-search endpoint.

SearchResult.title: SearchResult
SearchResult.description:
One search hit carried between pipeline steps.

This is the pipeline-domain projection of a search hit (upstream
``SearchResult``); it is the payload that search, rerank and merge
steps exchange. The retrieval layer exposes its own copy of the same
shape at its boundary; a step converts across the two when it must.

SessionListEnvelope.title: SessionListEnvelope
SessionListEnvelope.description:
``{"success": true, "data": [...], "total": n, "page": n, "page_size": n}``.

The list payload is a flat array at ``data`` with the paging
counters as envelope siblings, matching the upstream contract.

SpanLastError.title: SpanLastError
SpanLastError.description: Most recently finished failed span, for the timeline banner.

SpanNode.title: SpanNode
SpanNode.description: One node in the nested processing-span tree.

SpansRead.title: SpansRead
SpansRead.description: GET ``/knowledge/{id}/spans`` payload the timeline already consumes.

StorageBackendListResponse.title: StorageBackendListResponse
StorageBackendListResponse.description:
Wire for ``GET /storage-backends``.

Go returns ``{"success": true, "data": [...], "default_storage_backend_id": ...}``
— the list lives under ``data``, the default id at the top level.

StorageConnectivityEnvelope.title: StorageConnectivityEnvelope
StorageConnectivityEnvelope.description:
``{"success": bool, "error": "..."}`` — connectivity probe result.

A failed probe is a 200 with ``success=false``; the status stays 200 so
the UI renders the message inline instead of treating it as a request
error (Go's ``TestRaw`` / ``TestByID``).

StorageEngineCheckRequest.title: StorageEngineCheckRequest
StorageEngineCheckRequest.description:
Body for ``POST /system/storage-engine-check``.

``provider`` selects the storage engine; the engine-specific config
is carried in the ``config`` object (endpoint / credentials /
bucket per provider shape). Connectivity probing lands with the
storage-backend transport layer; this endpoint validates the
request shape and returns the standard envelope.

StorageProviderStatus.title: StorageProviderStatus
StorageProviderStatus.description: Wire shape for a storage engine status item (``StorageEngineStatusItem``).

SuggestionAttribution.title: SuggestionAttribution
SuggestionAttribution.description: Attribution record for a suggestion-sourced question.

SyncLog.title: SyncLog
SyncLog.description: Wire shape for one data-source sync log entry.

SystemInfoWireData.title: SystemInfoWireData
SystemInfoWireData.description: Inner data shape for the system info envelope.

SystemInfoWireResponse.title: SystemInfoWireResponse
SystemInfoWireResponse.description:
Wire shape for ``GET /system/info``.

Mirrors the upstream ``GetSystemInfoResponse`` struct — the
frozen ``SystemInfo`` contract in ``src/core.contracts.system``
holds the build-metadata fields, and the runtime fields the
upstream handler reports (``db_migration_error``, ``started_at``,
``uptime_seconds``) are added inline so the wire payload stays
backward-compatible with the Go response without touching the
immutable contract shape.

SystemSettingResponse.title: SystemSettingResponse
SystemSettingResponse.description: Wire shape for one system setting.

TagListEnvelope.title: TagListEnvelope
TagListEnvelope.description: ``{"success": true, "data": {total, page, page_size, data}}`` - list responses.

Tenant.title: Tenant
Tenant.description:
HTTP wire shape for a tenant.

All configuration blobs are optional and are populated only when the
caller's role permits access to workspace-level secrets.

TenantAPIKeyCreateEnvelope.title: TenantAPIKeyCreateEnvelope
TenantAPIKeyCreateEnvelope.description:
``{"success": true, "data": {..., "api_key": "<plaintext>"}}``.

The plaintext token is returned only by the create endpoint (mirrors
Go's ``tenantWithAPIKey``); every later read carries the key without
the credential.

TenantInvitationItem.title: TenantInvitationItem
TenantInvitationItem.description: One invitation row. Display names stay optional when no join filled them.

TenantInviteCandidate.title: TenantInviteCandidate
TenantInviteCandidate.description:
One row in the search-tenants-for-invite picker.

Mirrors the tenant-centric candidate shape: the workspace identity is
primary and the representative user is a label.

TenantList.title: TenantList
TenantList.description:
Paginated tenant listing.

Field names mirror Go's ``ListTenantsResponse`` / pagination
contract: ``data`` is the array of tenants (not ``items``);
``total``, ``page``, ``page_size`` are siblings at the envelope
level.

TenantListEnvelope.title: TenantListEnvelope
TenantListEnvelope.description:
``{"success": true, "data": [...], "total": ..., "page": ..., "page_size": ...}``.

Mirrors the project's pagination shape: ``data`` carries the list
payload (not ``items``) and the pagination metadata are siblings.

TenantMemberItem.title: TenantMemberItem
TenantMemberItem.description: One workspace member as the members table already renders it.

TestVectorStoreRawRequest.title: TestVectorStoreRawRequest
TestVectorStoreRawRequest.description:
Optional override for the frozen ``TestVectorStoreRequest``.

The frozen contract already matches this shape exactly; the
wrapper exists so the router can declare a single canonical
request body and the validation layer (Pydantic) reuses the
contract type.

UpdateChunkRequest.title: UpdateChunkRequest
UpdateChunkRequest.description:
Body for ``PUT /chunks/{knowledge_id}/{id}`` - every field optional.

``expected_revision`` is the optimistic-lock guard: when present it
must equal the chunk's current ``content_revision`` or the write
fails with a conflict; when absent the client-side staleness check is
skipped (the write's WHERE guard still rejects a concurrent edit).

UpdateKnowledgeBaseRequest.title: UpdateKnowledgeBaseRequest
UpdateKnowledgeBaseRequest.description:
Partial-update body: every field optional so callers can PATCH a subset.

The service layer skips a field when its value is ``None`` and
inherits the existing row's value, so the same request shape works
for both PUT (full body) and PATCH (subset).

UpdatePreferencesRequest.title: UpdatePreferencesRequest
UpdatePreferencesRequest.description:
PATCH body for ``PUT /auth/me/preferences``.

Fields are optional so the handler can distinguish "key not
present" (preserve existing value) from "explicit value"; send
``last_active_tenant_id=0`` to clear the preference. Mirrors Go's
``updateMyPreferencesRequest``.

UpdatePreferencesResponse.title: UpdatePreferencesResponse
UpdatePreferencesResponse.description: The merged preferences after a PATCH update.

UpdateSystemSettingRequest.title: UpdateSystemSettingRequest
UpdateSystemSettingRequest.description:
Body for ``PUT /system/admin/settings/{key}``.

``value`` carries the new value as raw JSON — int / string / bool /
list[str] depending on the registry-declared ``value_type``. The
service validates the type strictly and rejects mismatches with
400.

UpsertGeneratedQuestionRequest.title: UpsertGeneratedQuestionRequest
UpsertGeneratedQuestionRequest.description:
Body for ``PUT /chunks/by-id/{id}/questions``.

An empty ``question_id`` appends a fresh question; a known id replaces
the stored text. ``question`` is required.

UserInfo.title: UserInfo
UserInfo.description: Wire-side projection of a ``users`` row (sensitive columns stripped).

UserPreferences.title: UserPreferences
UserPreferences.description: Per-user UI/feature preferences. Stored as JSONB on Postgres.

VLMConfigBody.title: VLMConfigBody
VLMConfigBody.description: Optional VLM slot on the save-and-close body.

ValidateTokenResponse.title: ValidateTokenResponse
ValidateTokenResponse.description:
Token validation response. Returns the full user object on success.

Mirrors Go's ``internal/handler/auth.go`` ``ValidateToken`` which
emits ``{success, message, user}`` rather than the legacy
``{valid, user_id, tenant_id}`` minimal shape.

VectorStoreEnvelope.title: VectorStoreEnvelope
VectorStoreEnvelope.description: Wire shape for single-vector-store responses (post / get / put).

WikiConfig.title: WikiConfig
WikiConfig.description: Wiki-ingest settings for a knowledge base.

WikiFolderNodeView.title: WikiFolderNodeView
WikiFolderNodeView.description:
A folder node with its live page count and expand affordance.

The upstream node embeds the folder row, so the wire shape is flat
(folder fields + ``page_count`` + ``has_children``).

WikiFolderUpdateRequest.title: WikiFolderUpdateRequest
WikiFolderUpdateRequest.description:
Body for ``PUT /wiki/folders/{folder_id}``.

``parent_id`` is applied only when ``move_parent`` is true, so a pure
rename does not need to re-send the (possibly root) parent.

WikiFolderView.title: WikiFolderView
WikiFolderView.description: One wiki folder on the wire.

WikiGraphData.title: WikiGraphData
WikiGraphData.description: The link graph slice returned to a graph query.

WikiGraphEdge.title: WikiGraphEdge
WikiGraphEdge.description: A directed edge between two wiki page slugs.

WikiGraphMeta.title: WikiGraphMeta
WikiGraphMeta.description: How the returned subgraph relates to the full KB graph.

WikiGraphNode.title: WikiGraphNode
WikiGraphNode.description: One node of the wiki link graph.

WikiIndexData.title: WikiIndexData
WikiIndexData.description: The structured index payload — ``{intro, version, groups}``.

WikiIndexEntryView.title: WikiIndexEntryView
WikiIndexEntryView.description: One clickable directory entry in the index response.

WikiIndexGroupView.title: WikiIndexGroupView
WikiIndexGroupView.description: One page-type group in the index response.

WikiLintIssue.title: WikiLintIssue
WikiLintIssue.description: A single lint finding on one page.

WikiLintReport.title: WikiLintReport
WikiLintReport.description: The complete lint report for one wiki knowledge base.

WikiPageCreateRequest.title: WikiPageCreateRequest
WikiPageCreateRequest.description:
Body for ``POST /wiki/pages``.

``slug`` is required; every other content-bearing field is optional
and defaults to the empty value. Placement and directory caches are
recomputed server-side by the service.

WikiPageListData.title: WikiPageListData
WikiPageListData.description: Paginated page listing — ``{pages, total, page, page_size, total_pages}``.

WikiPageMoveRequest.title: WikiPageMoveRequest
WikiPageMoveRequest.description: Body for ``PUT /wiki/move-page`` — the page moves by slug.

WikiPageUpdateRequest.title: WikiPageUpdateRequest
WikiPageUpdateRequest.description:
Body for ``PUT /wiki/pages/{slug}``.

Absent fields keep their stored value; ``version`` (> 0) is the
optimistic-lock guard.

WikiPageView.title: WikiPageView
WikiPageView.description: One wiki page on the wire — mirrors the upstream ``WikiPage`` JSON.

WikiStats.title: WikiStats
WikiStats.description: Aggregate statistics about a KB's wiki.
